purpose: Inherited direct __call defers its body and keeps its real Child receiver through force-close.
source:
<?php
class Base85A {
    public function __call(string $name, array $arguments) {
        echo 'BODY|', $name === 'open', '|', $arguments === [85], '|',
             __CLASS__ === 'Base85A', '|', static::class === 'Child85A', '|';
        try { yield 85; }
        finally { echo 'FIN|', $this instanceof Child85A, '|'; }
    }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'MAKER|'; }
}
class Child85A extends Base85A {}
$maker = new Child85A();
$weak = WeakReference::create($maker);
echo 'OPEN|';
$g = $maker->open(85);
unset($maker);
echo 'FRESH|', $weak->get() !== null, '|';
echo 'VALUE|', $g->current() === 85, '|';
unset($g);
echo 'AFTER|', $weak->get() === null, '|';
unset($weak);
echo 'E';

purpose: Direct inherited __callStatic compares the whole packed array with its weakly observed payload, preserving cardinality and identity without the separate unimplemented COUNT intrinsic; payload retires on natural completion before closed Gen return86.

<?php
class Payload85B { public function __destruct() { echo 'ARG|'; } }
function NewPayload85B() {
    global $weakPayload;
    $payload = new Payload85B();
    $weakPayload = WeakReference::create($payload);
    return $payload;
}
class Base85B {
    public static function __callStatic(string $name, array $arguments) {
        global $weakPayload;
        echo 'BODY|', $name === 'open', '|', $arguments === [$weakPayload->get()], '|',
             $arguments[0] === $weakPayload->get(), '|',
             __CLASS__ === 'Base85B', '|', static::class === 'Child85B', '|';
        try { yield 85; return 86; }
        finally { echo 'FIN|', $weakPayload->get() !== null, '|'; }
    }
}
class Child85B extends Base85B {}
echo 'OPEN|';
$g = Child85B::open(NewPayload85B());
echo 'FRESH|', $weakPayload->get() !== null, '|';
echo 'VALUE|', $g->current() === 85, '|';
$g->next();
echo 'AFTER|', $weakPayload->get() === null, '|RETURN|', $g->getReturn() === 86, '|';
unset($g, $weakPayload);
echo 'E';

purpose: Independent direct inherited __call keeps its real receiver, promotes then retires the received array slot/local alias, and distinguishes ordinary cache and SEND owners through Fiber abort/drop without a BYREF handler signature.
source:
<?php
class Token85R {
    function __destruct() { echo 'TOKEN|'; }
}
class Input85R {
    function __construct() {
        global $weakInput;
        $weakInput = WeakReference::create($this);
    }
    function __destruct() { echo 'INPUT|'; }
}
function NewToken85R() {
    global $weakToken;
    $token = new Token85R();
    $weakToken = WeakReference::create($token);
    return $token;
}
class Base85R {
    public function __call(string $name, array $arguments) {
        global $weakMaker, $weakToken, $weakInput;
        echo 'BODY|', $name === 'open', '|', __CLASS__ === 'Base85R', '|',
             static::class === 'Leaf85R', '|', $this === $weakMaker->get(), '|';
        $alias =& $arguments[0];
        unset($arguments);
        try {
            $received = yield $alias;
            echo 'RECEIVED|', $received === $weakInput->get(), '|';
            unset($received, $alias);
            Fiber::suspend('direct85');
            echo 'BAD-RESUME|';
        } finally {
            echo 'FIN|', $weakMaker->get() instanceof Leaf85R, '|',
                 $weakToken->get() instanceof Token85R, '|',
                 $weakInput->get() instanceof Input85R, '|';
        }
    }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'MAKER|'; }
}
class Leaf85R extends Base85R {}
function Run85R() {
    global $g;
    echo 'SEND|';
    $g->send(new Input85R());
    echo 'BAD-CALLER|';
}
$maker = new Leaf85R();
$weakMaker = WeakReference::create($maker);
echo 'OPEN|';
$g = $maker->open(NewToken85R());
unset($maker);
echo 'FRESH|', $weakMaker->get() !== null, '|', $weakToken->get() instanceof Token85R, '|';
echo 'PRIME|';
$g->current();
$fiber = new Fiber('Run85R');
$stop = new Exception('stop85');
echo 'START|';
$mark = $fiber->start();
echo 'PARK|', $mark === 'direct85', '|', $g->current() === $weakToken->get(), '|',
     $weakInput->get() instanceof Input85R, '|';
echo 'ABORT|';
try { $fiber->throw($stop); }
catch (Throwable $e) {
    echo 'OUT|', $e === $stop, '|', $e->getPrevious() === null, '|',
         $fiber->isTerminated(), '|', $weakMaker->get() === null, '|',
         $weakInput->get() === null, '|', $weakToken->get() instanceof Token85R, '|';
}
echo 'CLOSED|', $g->current() === null, '|', $weakMaker->get() === null, '|',
     $weakToken->get() instanceof Token85R, '|';
unset($g, $fiber, $stop, $e);
echo 'DROP|', $weakToken->get() === null, '|E';
